title: DXF modeler group-order tolerance and open-source ACIS route ceilings
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement
scope: Cross-check DXF modeler group/subclass assumptions against Autodesk references
Inspect existing local modeler parser/writer controls for legal field-order coverage
Reconcile current open-source ACIS parser, carrier, kernel, and consumer boundaries
Specify the next fast, generated-only implementation test without changing validation cadence

sources.project: Autodesk DXF common entity group-code guidance
sources.observation: The order in group-code tables is typical, not guaranteed. The guidance does not authorize reordering ordered payload chunks or crossing entity subclass scopes.
3DSOLID has modeler subclass/version and proprietary group-1/3 content followed by AcDb3dSolid history handle group 350. This describes the DXF record, not B-rep semantics.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw parser and generated modeler tests
sources.observation: The switch-based parser retains ordered group-1/3 chunks, group-350 history, and proxy group-310 bytes distinctly. The generated modeler matrix now includes a legal AC1027 field-order variation and an odd-length group-310 negative control, asserting history/proxy/payload values and following LINE coordinates. This is a test-coverage improvement, not a reproduced bug.
The vendor describes ACIS SAT/SAB exchange as a commercial OCCT component, not an open-source-core importer.

The project documents experimental, profile-limited SAT/SAB parsing and CadQuery/OCCT shape conversion. PyPI provenance binds the package to a source revision; this does not make it an independent kernel from FreeCAD or a DWG/AcDs reader.
The stock importer documentation says DXF ACIS/SAT solids are not read; the DWG path depends on conversion to DXF and a selected importer backend.
Carrier parsing and a limited ACIS subset are documented, with unsupported records not constituting arbitrary B-rep semantics.

The release notes continue to describe R2013+ AcDsPrototype_1b SAB extraction as incomplete/not fully reliable. Current source work is not equivalent to released, independently qualified owner/key/payload association.
The report describes ACadSharp 3.4.9 omitting DWG-read 3DSOLID/REGION entities from DXF output, including solid-only blocks. It is not a current-release test or local defect reproduction.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Added a scratch-generated AC1027 DXF parser-order control to the existing modeler matrix. It verifies within-subclass field ordering, ordered payload chunks, group-310 proxy separation, group-350 history, malformed-chunk refusal, and following-entity continuity. No production behavior, support claim, dependency, or validation cadence changed.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue with the existing AC1027+ per-body block/INSERT and AcDs owner/key/payload disposition work; keep external semantic and native-platform gates at their composed checkpoints.
